page.content:
Woodlawn student whose 1999 murder is the crime Season 1 investigates.

How Hae Min Lee connects

  • Work: Serial Season 1 — Hae Min Lee is the murder victim at the center of Season 1.
  • Character: Adnan Syed — Adnan Syed was Hae Min Lee's ex-boyfriend and the man convicted of her murder.
  • Location: Woodlawn High School — Hae Min Lee was a student at Woodlawn High School.
  • Location: Leakin Park — Hae Min Lee's body was found in Leakin Park.

What is Hae Min Lee?

Hae Min Lee was an eighteen-year-old Woodlawn High student and athlete, Adnan Syed's ex-girlfriend, whose death in Baltimore is the absence Season 1 keeps trying to fill.

Key threads lead to Serial Season 1, Adnan Syed, Woodlawn High School and Leakin Park.
